cases.selection_criterion: Simultaneous left/right fingerpad contact AND >2cm lift in each of five consecutive control-step records.
cases.scope: Eight preregistered X15/V198 q0 interventions, each followed by seven native recipient-instruction queries with seed195+q. Only two natural matched-name references are eligible. Suffix transfer is instruction-context transfer, not a decoded identity, named head or unique MLP mediator. The same-live MLP comparison is controlled locally, while later trajectories are dynamic. Actual BF16 random strength matches pre-W only. Strict grasp, approach displacement and original milk-in-basket predicate remain separate. No original milk-instruction 15cm repair or half-denoising withdrawal test.
